clauses.title: CL-D81 records the packaged writer launch and its receiver-side check
clauses.section: ## CL-D81 — The exact-autofix writer launch is composed by a packaged builder
requires: tetsuh/pi-tidd-agents#152
`build_writer_launch` takes `created` — data of `workspace_create`, declared as a CL-D44 cross-operation field — and the `task` the parent decides
`agent: "tidd-autofix-worker"`, a role name and never a model, `task`, `cwd` at the created workspace

The built request goes to the subagent tool unchanged, as `build_gate_launch`'s does; nothing outside the builder may add a field to it, and no check enforces that, so it is stated where the parent reads it.
the receiver's flat parameter schema (`SubagentParams`, and from 0.77.0 `SubagentFlatParams`, #287), run over the document and not only read for the names it declares
Changing a field the builder emits, accepting another input from the parent, or dropping the receiver-side check requires a new owner decision
